properties.tree_description: Large mature pecan tree with two recent major limb failures. Both failures occurred at large branch attachments and have left substantial areas of exposed and damaged wood on the tree.
properties.comments: This tree has experienced two separate major limb failures within approximately seven weeks. The first occurred on July 27, 2026, when a large limb failed at its attachment to the tree and tore a long section of wood and bark from the stem. A second large limb fell last week. The broken end of the second limb has a large dark/open area within the wood. We are not arborists and cannot determine the underlying cause, but two major limb failures from the same tree in such a short period are very concerning. Both fallen limbs were large enough to cause serious injury or significant property damage. Given the size of the remaining tree and its proximity to our property and neighboring properties, we are concerned about additional limb or tree failure and are requesting approval for removal
